title: notes on default report
summary: rough notes to inform a design spec
content_html:
notes on default report

tags report is already close to the default.

  • the group filters and corresponding manifest group field are a customisation
  • it currently lacks the default ability to sort the list in manage mode, and a 'copy link' button on a doc page

report toolbar

all scopes (public + manage):

  • search by title

manage only:

  • New doc 📄
  • sort toggle button:
    • 🔤 = title asc
    • 🕒 = last_updated desc
  • Actions menu 🔧
    • Prepare package 📦
  • checkbox controls (Select all, clear, done)

list

  • list of doc titles
  • sorting is manage only
  • additional columns are customisations

doc toolbar

all scopes (public + manage):

  • ← back

manage only:

  • 🗑️ delete doc
  • 'Copy Link' button

manifest

public:

{
  "docs": [
    {
        "doc_id": "d-*",
        "title": "title"
    },

manage:

{
  "docs": [
    {
        "doc_id": "d-*",
        "title": "title"
        "ui_status": "",
        "viewable": true,
        "last_updated": ""
    },
